items.description: Identification as a randomised trial of a herbal medicine intervention in the title
Specific objectives or hypotheses, including any specific claims for the herbal medicine

The interventions for each group with sufficient details to allow replication, including:
(a) Herbal medicine name (and Latin binomial)
(b) Part of plant used
(c) Type of extract and solvent
(d) Dosage and frequency
(e) Method of standardization, if any
(f) Control intervention
For each primary and secondary outcome, results for each group, and the estimated effect size and its precision (such as 95% confidence interval)
Interpretation consistent with results, balancing benefits and harms, and considering other relevant evidence, including the specific context of the herbal medicine
